selection_method: Local screen of the top 1,000 ranked unannotated targets; selected <=70-line bodies with <=40 combined loads/stores and at least one understood direct callee. Five producers x ten targets; reviewers launched as producer files became available, overlapping QA with remaining production.
notes: The QA correction changed a broad player attribute curve name to compute_player_contextual_attribute_curve_value.
All 29 retained names were independently reviewed; the other 21 targets remain unnamed.
Review ran in parallel with production. This is one wave; rate varies by candidate complexity.
Token savings cannot be quantified; Luna low was explicitly selected.
